SiteContent.title: SiteContent
SiteContent.description: Complete site state including SITE metadata, ABOUT section, AUTHOR passport/note, TIPS, and the 9 ENTRIES.

site.description: Site-level title, tagline, and 5-stop route array.

about.description: About section title, text, photo reference, and Americanah note.

author.description: Author section note, portrait photo reference, nationality, and passport stamps.

tips.description: List of cabin tips / travel notes.

entries.description: List of the 9 blog entries with boarding pass metadata, text, photos, videoUrl, audioUrl, and qa.

MediaItem.title: MediaItem
MediaItem.description: Compressed browser JPEG photo stored as a data URL.

dataUrl.description: Base64 JPEG data URL compressed under 700 KB.

BackupRecord.title: BackupRecord
BackupRecord.description: Automatic snapshot backup of site/content (last 5 retained).

/site/{doc}.description: Live site content stored at site/content. Readable by everyone, writable only by the owner.

/media/{id}.description: Compressed image assets referenced as media:ID. Readable by everyone, writable only by the owner.

/backups/{id}.description: Last 5 automatic version backups. Readable and writable only by the owner.
